title: Rental Waiver Share for Storage Units at Another Facility (Bluegate Moving Truck Rental)
content:
On a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental free move-in contract, the waiver facility share depends on where the claimed storage unit — the storage unit whose claim the truck contract carries as its linked storage unit is, read from the facility and move-in date on its Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement and the truck contract's pickup facility and actual pickup date:

1. a unit at a facility other than the truck's pickup facility, with the truck picked up before the unit's move-in date, takes **0.9** of the waiver amount;
2. a unit at another facility with the truck picked up on or after the unit's move-in date takes **0.8**;
3. a unit at the pickup facility takes the whole waiver.

## Paired cases (hypothetical claimed unit moving in on 10 March)

| Claimed unit's facility | Actual pickup date | Share of the waiver amount |
|---|---|---|
| Another facility | 9 March | 0.9 — before the move-in date |
| Another facility | 10 March | 0.8 — on the move-in date |
| Another facility | 12 March | 0.8 — after the move-in date |
| The truck's pickup facility | Any date | Whole |
